long long n, b[20];
long long dfs(long long x, long long sum) {
    long long num = x / b[sum];
    x %= b[sum];
    if (x == 0) {
        return num * sum;
    } else {
        long long option1 = dfs(x, sum - 1);
        long long option2 = sum + dfs(b[sum] - x, sum - 1);
        return num * sum + min(option1, option2);
    }

    long long x = n;

        x /= 10;

    }

long long computeRepunit(int digits) {
    long long res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < digits; ++i) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long solve(long long x, int depth, const vector<long long>& repunits) {
    long long count = x / repunits[depth];
    x %= repunits[depth];
    if (x == 0) {
        return count * depth;
    }
    long long option1 = solve(x, depth - 1, repunits);
    long long option2 = depth + solve(repunits[depth] - x, depth - 1, repunits);
    return count * depth + min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<long long> repunits(20);
    repunits[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; ++i) {
        repunits[i] = computeRepunit(i);
    }
    long long digits = 0;
    long long temp = n;
    while (temp > 0) {
        temp /= 10;

    }
